many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]: cells[I[i][j]].append((i,j))
    colors=sorted(cells,key=lambda c:min(j for i,j in cells[c]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    s=0
    for c in colors:
        g=sorted(get_comps(I,c),key=lambda cp:min(p[1] for p in cp))   # ascending col: first rests on FLOOR
        ref=min(min(p[1] for p in cp) for cp in g)
        w=max(max(p[1] for p in cp)-min(p[1] for p in cp)+1 for cp in g)
        # chain going UPWARD from floor comp
        bottoms=[]; cur=H-1
        for cp in g[::-1]:            # upward from floor
            h=max(p[0] for p in cp)-min(p[0] for p in cp)
            bottoms.append(cur)
            cur -= h+1                # next comp up: bottom two rows above this comp's TOP? we want: upper_bottom = lower_top - 2
        # place from BOTTOM (last in reversed) = floor comp
        for k,cp in enumerate(g[::-1]):
            b=bottoms[k]
            h=max(p[0] for p in cp)-min(p[0] for p in cp)
            top=b-h+1
            base=min(p[0] for p in cp); bc=min(p[1] for p in cp)
            for p in cp:
                y,x=top+p[0]-base,s+(p[1]-bc)
                if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W: out[y][x]=c
        s+=w+1
    return out
